selection_rationale: cnd-7f4a2 (RAG+Formal Verifier vs LLM-only) directly targets an operationally meaningful NetOps safety question, is falsifiable with a paired within-task design, maps to documented literature/implementation gaps (end-to-end execution + verifier integration), and is feasible within available compute/model-call budget. It produces clear, testable primary outcomes (paired critical error rate) and aligns well with the CNSM Agentic AI Researcher track priorities (reliability/safety of agentic NetOps).
unresolved_uncertainties: Extent to which simulator-and-verifier results predict production-scale safety and whether benchmarked gains generalize to real networks (evidence_synthesis UQ3).
Whether LLM-only self-correction (without reliable external verifier feedback) can ever reliably guarantee configuration correctness in diverse NetOps tasks (UQ2).
Operational cost, latency, and SLA trade-offs introduced by RAG+verifier integrations under realistic production variability (UQ4).
Absence of existing evidence of safe autonomous execution of unapproved production network changes by LLM-based agents (UQ1).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify retrieval-corpus construction and publish a public snapshot/hash of the corpus used for RAG (selection rules, sources, indexing/embedding parameters).
Enumerate the verifier rule-set and map verifier failures to operational-critical categories; publish exact verifier checks, severity mapping, and counterexample formats used in the experiment.

Increase and document task diversity across vendors/protocols or justify representativeness; include an external-validation subset (vendor/device heterogeneity) and explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria for tasks.

Define the human-annotation protocol for criticality labels: rater selection/training, annotation guidelines, inter-rater agreement measurement, target sample size, and plan for handling disagreements (pre-register adjudication rules).

Add explicit scope/limitation on single-LLM generality or include at least one additional model for sensitivity checks (pre-register model identifiers, prompting templates, and per-model analysis plan).
